svg.title: Chips
svg.desc: Chips filter and steer. Selected is the theme inverse. Iris chips mark anything the system inferred about you. On imagery, chips go glass. · Wake, A Glance-inspired design system. Original vector artwork; not a Glance asset.
svg.text: Chips filter and steer. Selected is the theme inverse. Iris chips mark
anything the system inferred about you. On imagery, chips go glass.
Wake · A Glance-inspired design system · v1.0
FILTER ROW (HORIZONTAL SCROLL, 16PX LEADING MARGIN, NO TRAILING MARGIN)
· Selected = inverse fill. Never red: red is reserved for action and live.
· Iris variant only for system-inferred facets ("Because you like street style").
· Rows scroll; never wrap filter chips onto two lines.
